partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact molecular-activity GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: A drug that decreases a compact molecular activity enabled by a gain-of-function disease gene can counter the overactive molecular function.
results.body: drug decreases compact CTD molecular activity enabled by Gene2Phenotype GOF disease gene
results.mechanism_rationale: Drug direction opposes explicit variant direction at the gene's GOA molecular function, avoiding unsigned process-membership composition.
results.trapi_notes: The drug-activity, gene-function, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; provenance, variant form, activity degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(activity:MolecularActivity)
      <-[:ENABLES]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:ctd' IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND activity._miner_gene_enable_degree <= 58
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
